    LemmaAlmost-invariant events are trivial under an ergodic measure#✓fully proved

    StatMech.ConfigSpace.aeconst_of_ae_invariant

    Under an ergodic measure, a measurable set invariant up to null sets has measure 0 or 1. See also Mathlib's aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq for ErgodicSMul.

    lemma aeconst_of_ae_invariant
    {μ : Measure (ConfigSpace E)} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [Countable G]
    (hμ : IsErgodic (G := G) μ)
    {s : Set (ConfigSpace E)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hinv : ∀ g : G, (shift g : ConfigSpace E → ConfigSpace E) ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[μ] s) :
    μ s = 0 ∨ μ s = 1
    abbrev ConfigSpace (E : Type*) : Type _ := E → Bool

      (∀ g : G, (shift g : ConfigSpace E → ConfigSpace E) ⁻¹' s = s) →

    DefinitionSelf-mixing on cylinder events#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.fmc_SelfMixing

    For every cylinder event A and ε > 0 there is a translation g with |μ(A ∩ g⁻¹A) - μ(A)²| < ε.

    def fmc_SelfMixing [Countable E] (μ : Measure (ConfigSpace E)) : Prop :=
  ∀ A ∈ measurableCylinders (fun _ : E => Bool), ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ g : G, |μ.real (A ∩ (shift g : ConfigSpace E → ConfigSpace E) ⁻¹' A)
      - (μ.real A) ^ 2| < ε
    abbrev ConfigSpace (E : Type*) : Type _ := E → Bool

    MathlibExt/Probability/Configuration/ConfigSpace.lean:40

    def shift (g : G) (ω : ConfigSpace E) : ConfigSpace E := fun e => ω (g⁻¹ • e)

    DefinitionInclusion–exclusion coefficient of a multi-open event#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.fmu_traceCoef

    The inclusion–exclusion coefficient of O_T in the expansion of the trace indicator of τ on F.

    noncomputable def fmu_traceCoef [DecidableEq E] (F : Finset E) (τ : E → Bool) (T : Finset E) : ℝ :=
  (∏ e ∈ T, (if τ e then (1 : ℝ) else -1)) * (∏ e ∈ F \ T, (if τ e then (0 : ℝ) else 1))

    DefinitionPair mixing of multi-open events#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.fmu_PairMixing

    For every finite family of finite sets T and δ > 0 there is one translation g with |μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) - μ(O_T) μ(O_{T'})| < δ for all T, T' in the family.

    def fmu_PairMixing (μ : Measure (ConfigSpace E)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (P : Finset (Finset E)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
    ∃ g : G, ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ T' ∈ P,
      |μ.real (fmu_multiOpen T ∩
          (shift g : ConfigSpace E → ConfigSpace E) ⁻¹' fmu_multiOpen T')
        - μ.real (fmu_multiOpen T) * μ.real (fmu_multiOpen T')| < δ
    abbrev ConfigSpace (E : Type*) : Type _ := E → Bool

    DefinitionExtreme point of the invariant probability measures#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.IsInvariantExtremePoint

    μ is a translation-invariant probability measure that is not a nontrivial convex combination of two distinct translation-invariant probability measures.

    def IsInvariantExtremePoint (μ : Measure (ConfigSpace E)) : Prop :=
  IsTranslationInvariant (G := G) μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
    ∀ (ν₁ ν₂ : Measure (ConfigSpace E)) (a b : ℝ≥0∞),
      IsTranslationInvariant (G := G) ν₁ → IsTranslationInvariant (G := G) ν₂ →
        IsProbabilityMeasure ν₁ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν₂ →
          0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 → μ = a • ν₁ + b • ν₂ → ν₁ = ν₂
    abbrev ConfigSpace (E : Type*) : Type _ := E → Bool

    DefinitionConditional product cap for multi-open events in boxes#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.fdb_BoxConditionalProductCap

    For every finite family of finite edge sets and box index N, some translation g satisfies, for all large m: each O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'} is A ∩ B on Λ_m with A increasing and B depending only on edges outside some F, the conditional masses of A on the fibres of F (with a boundary graph containing the wired one) are at most μ_N(O_T), and the mass of B is at most μ_N(O_{T'}).

    StatMech.FK.fdb_BoxConditionalProductCap · 24 lines 
    def fdb_BoxConditionalProductCap {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (P : Finset (Finset (Sym2 (Site d)))) (N : ℕ),
    ∃ g : Multiplicative (Site d), ∀ᶠ m in atTop, ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ T' ∈ P,
      ∃ (F : Finset (Sym2 (boxVerts d m)))
        (S_A S_B : Set (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (boxVerts d m))))
        (C' : SimpleGraph (boxVerts d m)) (_ : DecidableRel C'.Adj),
        (fmu_multiOpen T ∩
          (shift g : ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)) → ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))
            ⁻¹' fmu_multiOpen T') = boxRestrict d m ⁻¹' (S_A ∩ S_B) ∧
        MeasurableSet (boxRestrict d m ⁻¹' (S_A ∩ S_B)) ∧
        MeasurableSet (boxRestrict d m ⁻¹' S_B) ∧
        IsIncreasing S_A ∧
        DependsOnOutside F S_B ∧
        boundaryCliqueGraph (boxBoundary d m) ≤ C' ∧
        (0 ≤ (wiredFiniteMeasure d N hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
            : Measure (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))).real (fmu_multiOpen T)) ∧
        (∀ ψ ∈ fibreReps F,
          (∑ ρ, S_A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ρ * condBcProb (boxGraph d m) C' p 2 F ψ ρ)
            ≤ (wiredFiniteMeasure d N hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
                : Measure (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))).real (fmu_multiOpen T)) ∧
        ((wiredFiniteMeasure d m hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
            : Measure (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))).real (boxRestrict d m ⁻¹' S_B)
          ≤ (wiredFiniteMeasure d N hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
              : Measure (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))).real (fmu_multiOpen T'))
    abbrev Site (d : ℕ) : Type := Fin d → ℤ

    StatMech.FK.fktc_wired_box_density_const_of_orbit

    lemma fktc_wired_box_density_const_of_orbit (S : BoxSym d) (N : ℕ)
    (EB : Finset (Sym2 (boxVerts d N))) (eb₀ : Sym2 (boxVerts d N)) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (horb : ∀ eb ∈ EB, ∃ k : ℕ, eb = (Sym2.map (S.lift N))^[k] eb₀) :
    ∀ eb ∈ EB, wiredEdgeDensity d 2 (edgeIncl d N eb) p
      = wiredEdgeDensity d 2 (edgeIncl d N eb₀) p
    structure BoxSym (d : ℕ) where
  /-- The underlying permutation of the sites. -/
  τ : Site d ≃ Site d
  /-- `τ` preserves nearest-neighbour adjacency. -/
  adj : ∀ x y, (hypercubicLattice d).Adj (τ x) (τ y) ↔ (hypercubicLattice d).Adj x y
  /-- `τ` maps each centered box onto itself. -/
  box_mem : ∀ n x, τ x ∈ box d n ↔ x ∈ box d n

    noncomputable def cdc_wiredDecaySet {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (g : Multiplicative (Site d)) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Submodule ℝ C(ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)), ℝ) where
  carrier := {h | Tendsto (isd_decayFun
      (fun n => wiredFiniteMeasure d (φ n) hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)) g
      (BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact h)) atTop (𝓝 0)}
  add_mem' {h h'} hh hh' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hh hh' ⊢
    have hsum := hh.add hh'
    rw [add_zero] at hsum
    refine hsum.congr (fun n => ?_)
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_add, cdc_decayFun_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    have hz : isd_decayFun
        (fun n => wiredFiniteMeasure d (φ n) hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)) g
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact (0 : C(ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)), ℝ)))
      = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      funext n
      rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_zero, cdc_decayFun_zero]
    rw [hz]; exact tendsto_const_nhds
  smul_mem' c h hh := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hh ⊢
    have hsmul := hh.const_mul c
    rw [mul_zero] at hsmul
    refine hsmul.congr (fun n => ?_)
    have hms : BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact (c • h)
        = c • BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact h := rfl
    rw [hms, cdc_decayFun_smul]

    DefinitionDisjoint-box factorization bound for box measures#✓fully proved

    StatMech.FK.fwm_WiredDisjointBoxFactorise

    The disjoint-box factorization bound for a family of box measures μbox: for every finite family P of edge sets realized in Λ_N there are a translation g and r such that each T ∪ g⁻¹·T' lies in Λ_(N+r) and μbox (N+r) (T open, g·T' open) ≤ μbox N (T open) · μbox N (T' open). The parameters p only index the family.

    def fwm_WiredDisjointBoxFactorise {p : ℝ} (_hp : 0 < p) (_hp1 : p < 1)
    (μbox : ℕ → Measure (ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))) : Prop :=
  ∀ (P : Finset (Finset (Sym2 (Site d)))) (N : ℕ),
    (∀ T ∈ P, ∃ t : Finset (Sym2 (boxVerts d N)), T = t.image (edgeIncl d N)) →
    ∃ (g : Multiplicative (Site d)) (r : ℕ), ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ T' ∈ P,
      (∃ t : Finset (Sym2 (boxVerts d (N + r))),
          T ∪ T'.image (fun e => g⁻¹ • e) = t.image (edgeIncl d (N + r)))
      ∧ (μbox (N + r)).real (fmu_multiOpen T ∩
            (shift g : ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)) → ConfigSpace (Sym2 (Site d)))
              ⁻¹' fmu_multiOpen T')
          ≤ (μbox N).real (fmu_multiOpen T) * (μbox N).real (fmu_multiOpen T')
    abbrev ConfigSpace (E : Type*) : Type _ := E → Bool
